records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Works
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, zero tickets, and no customer reply to three outreaches or the held welcome call ([email:02754d74], [calendar:5b93f1dc], [email:84f0c82c]). Complete silence after an attended call signals low intent; 8 days remain, so some chance of self-start, but low.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up on our welcome call last week — I know a new tool can be easy to put off when the week fills up.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
